en.headline: Research Grants Council awards record HK$478 million to 12 university projects
en.dek: More than one-third of the supported proposals under the Areas of Excellence and Theme-based Research schemes involve artificial intelligence applications.
body: The Research Grants Council announced on 29 July the funding results for the Areas of Excellence Scheme 2026/27 and the Theme-based Research Scheme 2026/27, supporting a record 12 projects with a total of about HK$478 million.

Four projects under the Areas of Excellence Scheme received HK$158 million, covering medical imaging technology, smart manufacturing, neutron scattering and an exploratory study on sustainable wildlife trade. Eight projects under the Theme-based Research Scheme received HK$320 million, spanning healthcare, green technology and artificial intelligence.

RGC Chairman Professor Timothy W. Tong said the selected proposals aligned with national development priorities and Hong Kong’s push for new industrialisation. He noted that over one-third involved AI applications, including AI-based therapy monitoring, AI risk management for businesses, AI-driven urban emergency response and human-AI interaction.

The council said the projects would help consolidate Hong Kong’s position in higher education and technological innovation while addressing societal needs in medical technology, sustainable energy and disaster prevention.

zh.headline: 研資局撥款約4.78億元支持12個大學研究項目
zh.dek: 卓越學科領域計劃及主題研究計劃合共支持破紀錄12個項目，逾三分之一涉及人工智能應用。
body: 研究資助局於7月29日公布2026/27年度卓越學科領域計劃及主題研究計劃的撥款結果，合共支持12個項目，總額約4.78億元，創歷來新高。
卓越學科領域計劃下四個項目獲撥1.58億元，涵蓋醫學影像技術、智能製造、中子散射及可持續野生動植物貿易探索性研究。主題研究計劃下八個項目獲撥3.2億元，涉及醫療健康、綠色科技及人工智能等範疇。
研資局主席唐偉章教授表示，獲選項目符合國家發展策略及本港推動新型工業化的方向。他指出，逾三分之一項目涉及人工智能應用，包括以人工智能監察治療、企業人工智能風險管理、人工智能驅動城市應急回應及人機互動等。
研資局表示，有關項目有助鞏固香港在高等教育及科技創新的地位，同時回應醫療技術、可持續能源及防災等社會需要。
